corrections.reason: Stage-1 OCR hallucinated a non-Ethiopic Devanagari character in place of the Ge'ez Fidel 'ዪ' in 'ተኃሥዪ' (John 20:13, matching Col 2 L05).
Slight ink bleed at the top of 'ወ' caused it to be misread as 'ሠ'; both the image and Ge'ez grammar ('ኀበ ወሰድዎ' - where they have laid/taken Him, translated in L28 as 'ከወሰዱበት') confirm 'ወሰድዎ'.
This line is the second part of the root Ge'ez Gospel verse (John 20:18) and should be enclosed in root Ge'ez markers.
